title: Release-note screenshot pack for model launches and retirements
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Goal: Produce a polished, platform-consistent screenshot and visual asset pack used in release notes, quickstart pages, and the model catalog UI to announce new model additions and planned deprecations. Scope includes: (1) hero screenshot for release notes (web and mobile widths), (2) model detail tile mockups showing performance metrics and pricing, (3) deprecation banners and migration CTA visuals, (4) small inline thumbnails for changelog lists, and (5) a short guide for engineers/content authors on which image to use where and filename conventions. Deliver assets in PNG and SVG, include a Figma file with labeled components and export slices. Follow the Redwood visual system (colors, type scale) and make sure pricing breakdowns match the latest pricing spec from PM.
acceptance_criteria: Hero release-note screenshots: desktop (1200x600) and mobile (828x450) exported in PNG and SVG
Model detail tile mockups: three variants (new model, recommended replacement, deprecated) with consistent token-cost breakdowns
Deprecation banner: two CTA states (Upgrade guide + Auto-migration flow) and a compact inline version for changelogs
All assets annotated in Figma with copy text and export settings; tokens and pricing numbers verified against PM pricing doc
Design handoff doc in Drive with filename conventions and recommended markdown snippets for engineers/content authors
design_steps: Kickoff with PM + engineering to confirm pricing numbers and migration messaging
Wireframe quick variants and CTA copy (internal review)
High-fidelity comps in Figma and export slices
Upload assets to Drive and prepare handoff doc
Final review with PM + content + engineering, iterate, then mark approved
